title: brassaia mathewsii
intro: Brassaia mathewsii, commonly known as the Black Poui, is a plant species in the Annonaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine in various parts of the world, particularly in the Caribbean, for its potential health benefits. Research has shown that Brassaia mathewsii may possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which could contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
